role: read-only software/physics evidence audit; AI-authored support, not student final research design or interpretation

already_verified.claim: native undamped constant-coefficient Dirichlet Helmholtz sparse assembly agrees with independent DST; manufactured sine forcing gives second-order spatial convergence
already_verified.limit: No absorbing-boundary fidelity, variable-coefficient PDE convergence or time-domain transfer.

already_verified.claim: Devito adapter fixes sample times/CFL, rejects unlabeled or mismatched observations, and pulls edge-extended parameter gradients back by the adjoint extension
already_verified.limit: A discrete gradient check is not a boundary-error or continuum-error check.

already_verified.claim: one downsampled Marmousi exact baseline executes forward/adjoint and five L-BFGS-B iterations
already_verified.limit: One geometry/one numerical model; Devito-generated observations; optimizer stopped at iteration cap; no WaveCert surrogate/certificate path is exercised.

genuinely_missing: No recorded damping-layer reflection/error measurement against an exterior-domain reference. FD agreement can hold even when boundary reflections contaminate both truth and inversion.

No Devito spatial/time refinement comparison on the same physical domain, matched source coordinates and source-volume normalization. Existing continuum-order evidence belongs only to the separate undamped Helmholtz operator.

No validated operator/derivative/bound bridge from the certificate native Dirichlet five-point K and quadratic all-side imaginary damping to the actual Devito fourth-order spatial stencil and its additive absorbing layer.

No free-surface extension: current Model construction does not pass fs=True; current padding pullback assumes symmetric all-side padding. PML, attenuation, variable density and elastic physics are also unproved.
No several-independent-geological-ancestor demonstration is supplied by a homogeneous physics verification or one Marmousi model.

smallest_next_verification.name: forward-only homogeneous damping-layer boundary-truncation diagnostic
smallest_next_verification.why_this_next: Closes an explicitly missing physical-fidelity measurement using the current supported adapter, without inventing a new solver, parameterization or final research hypothesis.
smallest_next_verification.mechanism: Compare current adapter receiver traces in a small homogeneous box with translated source/receiver coordinates in a substantially enlarged homogeneous box, using identical spacing, dt, wavelet, velocity and interpolation. Reference time window ends before its first possible exterior return. Include the undamped small box as a positive contamination control. Inspect both early direct-wave agreement and later difference energy; retain the raw traces and travel-time justification.

bounded_fixture_option_not_a_final_study.caution: These numbers are an executable engineering fixture option, not registered student experimental choices. Check source support and actual discrete arrival behavior before treating a time gate as clean; a same-code enlarged box isolates truncation, not independent implementation error.

smallest_next_verification.analytical_guard_for_fixture: At c=2m/ms the nearest reference physical right boundary image path is2350m, giving1175ms before source delay; padded reference exterior is still farther. A1100ms record is intended to end earlier. Report the actual temporal source samples and all early-wave discrepancies rather than assuming perfect compact support.
smallest_next_verification.memory: forward(save=False) uses three time slices in the installed ForwardOperator. Largest padded grid321x321 float64 wavefield needs3*321*321*8=2472984bytes before halos; additional model/source/receiver/compiler/process memory is separate. No n_time-by-grid history is needed.
smallest_next_verification.what_it_could_support: Quantified truncation/reflection behavior of this damped discrete backend for this homogeneous source band and geometry only.
smallest_next_verification.what_it_cannot_support: No PML/free-surface validation, certificate transfer, native-geology generalization, matched-cost inversion advantage or full goal2 completion.

unit_and_transfer_obligations.verified_convention: Devito seismic examples use m, ms, velocity km/s numerically equal to m/ms; f0=.010 is10Hz. The local forward kernel is m*u.dt2-laplace(u)+damp*u.dt=q; sparse source update is src*dt**2/m, with no automatic physical cell-volume factor.
unit_and_transfer_obligations.conditional_conversion: If converting the same continuous equation from m/ms to km/s, numerical squared slowness is unchanged, d_Helmholtz=1000*d_Devito and q_Helmholtz=1e6*q_Devito. A physical point-source normalization needs its own1/h**2 factor. This is dimensional algebra, not implemented cross-backend validation.
unit_and_transfer_obligations.time_discretization: A finite-dt temporal Fourier symbol differs from continuous omega and finite-window transforms include endpoint terms. Equal frequency labels are insufficient for an operator identity.
unit_and_transfer_obligations.certificate_derivative: For edge-extension E, a physical direction is E*v and the physical gradient is E.T*g_padded. Any future bound must use the actual operator/stencil/damping and physical receiver/source maps. Do not patch the nominal native operator behind the frozen oracle.

memory_limit_for_later_gradients: Current objective_and_gradient always uses save=True. It cannot safely scale to a full619x1000 native slice with thousands of time steps on8GiB. Installed AcousticWaveSolver has checkpointing code, but this adapter does not enable it and pyrevolve availability/recomputation cost are not established. Restrict new verification to forward-only or bounded saved grids until a separately verified checkpoint adapter exists.
completion_state: Goal2 remains unproved. A boundary diagnostic is a concrete software-verification advance; final realistic-physics choice and several independent geological environments still require actual evidence and student scientific decisions.
